subject: MdePkg, MdeModulePkg/ArmFfaLib: add funcs to get partition info via regs
reasons: This is API creation: new helper functions and header declarations are added.
The commit does not transform existing call sites, so there is no repeated before/after pattern to generalize.
The change is foundational work for later migrations, not itself a migration.
Coccinelle is not the right tool for introducing the helper layer.
